LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingNeighbourCalls: Neighbours ask for help by radio
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingNeighbourCallsDesc: Now and then, about once a fortnight, a faction that is not hostile with a settlement in radio reach asks for your best doctor or mechanic on the radio for an hour. Saying yes earns goodwill once the hour is done; saying no costs nothing. On by default.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioNeighbour_Text: A call comes in by radio from {SETTLEMENT}, a settlement of {FACTION}. They are short of {ROLE} and have heard of {COLONIST}'s {SKILL}.\n\nCould {COLONIST} spend an hour on the radio talking them through it? {FACTION} would be grateful: {GOODWILL} goodwill once the hour is done. Saying no costs nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioNeighbour_CannotNow: {COLONIST} cannot take the call now: busy, out of radio touch, or the neighbours no longer talk to us.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioNeighbour_NoneToAsk: No neighbour in radio reach has anyone to ask for.
